properties.displayName: CCC.Core.CN05 - AKS clusters must be private (API server not publicly reachable)
properties.description: Denies AKS managed clusters that do not enable a private API server. A private cluster keeps the API server reachable only from within the trust perimeter (API Server VNet Integration / private link). Maps to FINOS CCC Core CN05 (Prevent Access from Untrusted Entities) and enforces the AVM aks sample setting 'api_server_access_profile.enable_private_cluster = true'.

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of the policy.
